text:
What can I actually do for your business?

Two things. Get you found when people search for what you do, on the map, in the results and in the ads. Then keep you in front of them on Google, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram until they're ready to call.

Judge me on calls, enquiries and booked jobs.

Google's own video on hiring an SEO says it usually takes four months to a year to see the benefit.

A tradie in a country town with a half-filled profile can climb quickly. A clinic in Bondi Junction up against forty others takes longer.

Anyone quoting a timeline before looking is guessing.

If you run Google Ads, someone should be checking the account every week.

Google keeps adding settings, and some switch themselves on. Most don't matter. A few quietly cost money.

Quick test: open Change history. If Google made the last changes, or nobody's touched it in months, it's on autopilot.
